text:
riley: Quick heads-up  opened a small PR to harmonize v1->v2 snippets across quickstarts and guides. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1367
noor: saw it. main issues I flagged: curl examples using X-Old-Auth, several places still call models.invoke, and a handful of embed quickstarts reference embed-legacy-512.
evan: my recommendation: make v2 the canonical copy (clean, runnable examples) and add a compact, collapsible 'v1 -> v2 mapping' at the top of each page for teams on the shim. keep the compatibility text minimal so pages are easy to scan.
sam: i'll add tiny Go and Ruby snippets and a short JS/Python polyfill called invoke_v1_compat that maps old kwargs to the new responses.create call. will also tidy streaming examples to use the SDK stream helper.
docs-ci-bot: [ci] example-lint failed on examples/quickstart.md: found header 'X-Old-Auth' and 'models.invoke' usage.
riley: thanks bot. i'll sweep curl headers to use 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' and update endpoints to /v2/responses. also will add a two-line stream hint recommending SDK helpers instead of ad-hoc newline framing.
noor: add an embeddings note: embed-legacy-512 -> rwd-embed-512-v2 and link to /assets/alias_map_v2.json in the footnote. that avoids support churn.
evan: also include a tiny code polyfill showing how to read outputs safely (v2 has outputs array vs old output_text). one small example each for js/py.
riley: draft replacement curl in PR description: 
# OLD (v1)
curl -H "X-Old-Auth: $KEY" -d '{"model":"gpt-3.5","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/invoke
# NEW (v2 canonical)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses

sam: pushed snippets and polyfills. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1367/files
noor: product asked for a single deprecation line we can reuse in changelog/comms: "Docs examples standardized to v2 canonical patterns; v1 shim supported until 2025-12-31." please add to changelog.
evan: action items: (1) Sam: add Go/Ruby + polyfills + streaming fix and update example tests; (2) Riley: sweep curl and quickstart headers + add collapsible mapping snippet; (3) Noor: add changelog entry and embed alias footnote; (4) Evan: review and merge after 2 approvals + examples CI green.
sam: running local smoke tests now. will update when CI finishes.
riley: thanks all  merging once CI is clean. :shipit:
